5 تفسّأ , said of a garment, or piece of cloth, (S, M, O, K,) It became ragged, or dissundered, (S, O,) and worn out: (S:) like تقضّأ, or تفصّأ: (accord. to different copies of the S: the latter in the L:) or it became rent. (M, O.) ―
-b2- تفسّأ فِيهِمْ, (K,) or بِهِمْ, (O,) said of a disease, It spread among them, (O, K,) and became common among them: (TA:) like تفشّأ. (O, K.) ＝
-A2- تفسّأ: see 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
